task_summary: Plan a concise unified release-note contract for Atlas Notes 2.4.1. The outcome paragraph will state the maintenance fix without suggesting a feature or performance gain. The checklist paragraph will require a reviewer to confirm the four required facts and the absence of any extra promise. Optional editorial polish remains separate and cannot alter those facts.

decision_record.decision: Describe the reconnect issue as a stale sync status label fix.
decision_record.because: This states the customer-visible maintenance change without broadening it into a sync behavior or performance claim.
decision_record.risk: Loose wording could imply that syncing itself became faster or more reliable.

decision_record.decision: State that offline edits were already queued before version 2.4.1.
decision_record.because: The draft omits this required context, which prevents readers from mistaking existing behavior for a new feature.
decision_record.risk: Ambiguous tense could make existing offline queuing sound newly introduced.

decision_record.decision: Keep optional editorial improvements outside the required contract.
decision_record.because: Tone and phrasing may be refined only after the required facts and promise boundary are fixed.
decision_record.risk: Editorial additions could introduce unsupported benefits or duplicate required facts.

proposed_change_manifest.change: Identify Atlas Notes 2.4.1 as a maintenance update that fixes a sync status label which could retain stale text after reconnecting.
proposed_change_manifest.reason: This supplies the version and exact customer-visible fix while keeping the claim narrow.

proposed_change_manifest.change: State that the update adds no new user-facing feature and that offline edits were already queued before this update.
proposed_change_manifest.reason: This prevents existing behavior from being presented as new and completes the required context.

proposed_change_manifest.change: Remove any wording that says or implies sync is faster.
proposed_change_manifest.reason: Sync performance is outside the update and must not become a customer-visible promise.

proposed_change_manifest.change: Require one reviewer to confirm the four required facts and verify that the note contains no extra promise.
proposed_change_manifest.reason: This is the defined acceptance check for the unified contract.

proposed_change_manifest.change: Allow concise tone, ordering, and readability edits only after the contract passes review; do not change claims.
proposed_change_manifest.reason: This separates optional wording improvements from required release-note content.

acceptance_mapping.evidence: The outcome paragraph explicitly identifies Atlas Notes version 2.4.1.
The planned note states that reconnecting could leave stale text in the sync status label and that this update fixes it.
The outcome paragraph explicitly says the update adds no new user-facing feature.
The outcome paragraph states that offline edits were already queued before this update.
The promise boundary removes faster-sync wording and bars any implied performance gain.
The checklist requires reviewer confirmation of the four required facts and no extra promise.
